assign.request: What real-time substrate serves text chat first and grows to voice, recording and transcripts - legally?
steps: read start-from docs (durable-objects.md, wire.md, Socket.js, JSONL readme)
text chat on DOs: shape, cap, fan-out cost, history, presence

assign.now: log complete (36 lines), verdict.md written, running --check and closing out

log.msg: verdict recommends one DO per channel (not per topic); flags a direct conflict with research/cloudflare verdict which picked one DO per topic -- unresolved, needs owner tie-break

assign.outcome: **Real-time substrate researched: text-first DO chat, growing to voice legally** — [verdict](/imagine/platform/research/realtime/verdict/) · [log, 36 lines](/imagine/platform/research/realtime/). MVP: one hibernating Durable Object per channel (not per topic — argued, and it directly conflicts with `research/cloudflare`'s per-topic pick, flagged unresolved for the owner). Client change is one line in `Socket.js`. No voice/recording in the MVP; first voice cost is Cloudflare Realtime's flat $0.05/GB egress. All 7 closed questions answered; all 4 challenge claims addressed (recording-by-default rejected, voice-in-MVP rejected, per-topic DO rejected, WS-beats-SSE+POST confirmed via the hibernation-is-WS-only finding). Left open: whether per-message DO fan-out cost actually scales with room size at 10k+ (no published benchmark, logged as a question), and a searchable transcript index (not investigated).
